newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Cruz Azul to invest $120 mln in cement.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Cruz Azul to invest $120 mln in cement.

text.p: Mexican cement maker Cooperativa Cruz Azul SA announced Monday it plans to invest $120 million in building a new cement plant.
The company said the plant will be based in the city of Aguascalientes in Aguascalientes state and will have an installed capacity of 1 million tonnes per year of Portland-type cement.
The plant will be added to Cruz Azul's two other existing cement plants in Cruz Azul, Hidalgo state, and Lagunas, Oaxaca state. Cruz Azul did not give a start-up date..

"Total production capacity will be around 6.5 million tonnes per year..." Director General Guillermo Alvarez Cuevas said in a statement, giving the planned estimated capacity for the company's three plants.
Cruz Azul said the new plant would boost the company's exports and would directly employ around 2,000 people.
